text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs joint meeting of the Revolutionary Command Council and the Regional Command of the Baath party.
- Trade Ministry selling car spare parts, electrical household goods and other goods at prices lower than in commercial market.
- King Hussein postpones visit to the United States.
- U.N. envoy Rolf Ekeus (in charge of scrapping Iraq's weapons) serves American interest.
- National Assembly organises a week in solidarity with Iraqi prisoners of war detained in Iran.
- Libya accuses the United States of renewing embargo.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Police arrest a gang of thieves who rob houses and steal cars.
- French firm is ready to supply Iraq with agricultural pesticide.
